description: The review categorizes the AI tools used across the 22 studies into eight functionality-based classes: NLP, chatbots and virtual tutors, gamification, adaptive learning platforms, speech and pronunciation tools, content creation and management tools, AI-powered assessment tools, and VR/AR.
title: Eight-category functional taxonomy of AI technologies in school EFL teaching

description: The review organizes the field into eight AI technology categories identified through preliminary scoping: intelligent tutoring systems and conversational AI, automated assessment and feedback, learning analytics and predictive modeling, computer vision for engagement monitoring, multimodal sensing
title: Eight-category taxonomy of AI technologies in elementary STEM education

description: The review organizes transition programs into eight mutually exclusive categories, realigned from the 15 NSTTAC predictor categories retained after eliminating exit exam requirements.
title: Eight-category taxonomy of transition program approaches for students with disabilities

description: The review derives a taxonomy that organizes video characteristics and contextual aspects into eight categories: audio features, visual features, textual features, instructor behavior, learners' activities, interactive features, production style, and instructional design.
title: Eight-category taxonomy of video characteristics and contextual aspects for video-based learning

description: The article describes a machine-learning pipeline for automatic short-answer scoring comprising eight stages: data collection, scoring/labeling, preprocessing, feature engineering, model selection, data split, model training, and model evaluation.
title: Eight-stage machine-learning pipeline for automatic scoring with stage-specific bias vulnerabilities

description: The article maps community integration onto eight synthesis stages: planning and protocol development, literature search, study identification, coding and data extraction, data analysis, results interpretation, reporting, and dissemination.
title: Eight-stage synthesis process with participatory integration actions at each stage

description: A set of eight generalizable tags (course logistics and fit, curriculum, teaching modality, teaching, assessment, resources, peer and teacher interaction, other) developed by the authors for multi-label classification of open-ended course feedback.
title: Eight-tag course feedback classification system

description: The review constructs eight recurring themes via reflexive thematic analysis of 18 studies: GenAI reconfigures knowledge development, reshapes higher-order thinking, mediates communication, transforms team interaction, improves administrative efficiency, provides personalised feedback, and raises da
title: Eight-theme analytical framework for GenAI in higher-education group work

description: The article defines eight annotated intraoperative milestones (timepoints A through H) from surgical video, from which two composite metrics are computed: the pure RiSSA interval, which \"represents the net duration of the whole RiSSA procedure, excluding specimen extraction\", and total purse-string
title: Eight-timepoint video annotation method for pure RiSSA and purse-string suture skill assessment

description: The review's central contribution is an evaluative framework of eight criteria that an AI system must satisfy before its cognitive-model status is granted rather than assumed: theoretical grounding, construct validity, mechanistic transparency, alignment with human learning trajectories, error-signa
title: Eight validity criteria for AI systems as cognitive models of learning
